title: 🔥 "IS A PERSON WHO COMMITS SUICIDE SAVED? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IS A PERSON WHO COMMITS SUICIDE SAVED? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?" 🚀🔥

📖 1 Corinthians 3:16-17 – "Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in you? If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple."
Suicide is one of the most painful and controversial topics, especially for families who have lost loved ones in this way. Many ask:

❌ "If a Christian commits suicide, do they go straight to hell?"
❌ "Can someone take their own life and still be saved?"
❌ "Is suicide an unforgivable sin?"
🚨 What does the Bible really say? Let’s dive into Scripture and uncover the truth.

🔥 1. SUICIDE IS A SIN – IT IS SELF-MURDER
📖 Exodus 20:13 – "You shall not murder."

✅ Suicide is self-murder—taking a life that belongs to God.
✅ The Bible condemns all forms of murder, including killing oneself.
✅ Our bodies belong to God, not to us (1 Corinthians 6:19-20).
📖 Romans 14:7-8 – "For none of us lives to himself, and none of us dies to himself. If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord."
🚨 Life is a gift from God. We do not have the right to take it!

🔥 2. WHAT HAPPENS TO SOMEONE WHO COMMITS SUICIDE?
There are two scenarios we must consider:
1️⃣ The person was an unbeliever (rejected Christ).

If someone dies without Christ, no matter how they die, they go to hell (John 3:36, Revelation 20:15).
Suicide does not send them to hell—unbelief does!
2️⃣ The person was a true, born-again believer.

This is more complicated, but we must ask: Does one final sin erase salvation?
📖 Romans 8:38-39 – "For I am sure that neither death nor life… nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord."

✅ If a person was truly saved, their last action (suicide) does not override God’s grace.
✅ Suicide is still a sin, but it is not the "unforgivable sin."
✅ However, this does NOT mean suicide is acceptable!
🚨 Suicide is a tragedy, but salvation depends on faith in Jesus, not on how someone dies.

🔥 3. WHAT IS THE UNFORGIVABLE SIN?
📖 Matthew 12:31-32 – "Every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven, but the blasphemy against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven."

✅ The ONLY unforgivable sin is rejecting the Holy Spirit’s call to salvation.
✅ Suicide is NOT the unforgivable sin.
✅ The true danger is if a person commits suicide while rejecting Jesus—they die in unbelief!
🚨 The biggest issue is NOT suicide—it’s whether someone knew Jesus as their Savior before they died!

🔥 4. BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF SUICIDE – DID THEY GO TO HELL?
📖 Judas Iscariot (Matthew 27:5) – Betrayed Jesus, felt guilty, and hanged himself.
🚨 Judas went to hell—not because of suicide, but because he rejected Christ! (John 17:12)

📖 King Saul (1 Samuel 31:4-6) – Fell on his own sword.
📖 Samson (Judges 16:28-30) – Pulled down the temple, killing himself and his enemies.
✅ Samson is mentioned in Hebrews 11:32 as a man of faith—suggesting he was saved despite his final act!
🚨 The Bible does not say all suicides go to hell—it depends on their faith in God!

🔥 5. SUICIDE IS A SPIRITUAL ATTACK FROM SATAN!
📖 John 10:10 – "The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life and have it abundantly."

✅ Suicide is NEVER from God—it is a LIE from Satan!
✅ The devil wants people to believe there is "no way out" and that "death is the only option."
✅ But Jesus offers hope, healing, and deliverance!
🚨 No matter how bad things seem, suicide is NOT the answer—Jesus is!

🔥 6. WARNING: SUICIDE HAS DEVASTATING CONSEQUENCES!
📖 Ecclesiastes 7:17 – "Why should you die before your time?"

✅ Suicide is irreversible—it cannot be undone!
✅ It causes extreme pain to family and loved ones.
✅ It cuts short the plans God had for that person’s life.
🚨 If you are struggling with suicidal thoughts, SEEK HELP NOW!
📖 Psalm 34:17-18 – "The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit."
🔥 Jesus can heal every pain, every wound, and every broken heart!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: DOES SUICIDE SEND A PERSON TO HELL?
✅ Suicide is a sin, but it is NOT the unforgivable sin.
✅ If someone was a true believer, suicide does NOT erase their salvation.
✅ However, suicide is NEVER God's will—it is a lie from Satan!
✅ The real danger is dying without Christ—THAT is what sends a person to hell!
🚨 DO NOT LET SATAN WIN! CHOOSE LIFE!
